subject: Request: latest penetration executive summary + evidence share plan
messages:
From: John Smith <john.smith@acmecorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest penetration test executive summary and transfer plan

Hi Marcus,

We’re preparing our monthly SIG assessment and need the latest penetration test executive summary for Redwood’s hosted API surface (public endpoints, API keys handling, and log retention behavior). Can you confirm:

- Do you have an executive summary (one- to two-page) you can share today?
- What is the scope of the test that produced that summary (version, publicly-hosted endpoints, internal admin panels, cloud infra)?
- What secure transfer options do you support for exchanging the full redacted report and supplemental evidence (S3 presign, encrypted container, vendor portal)?

We may need the full redacted report for our internal audit team and proof that identified findings were remediated. Our compliance window is tight — ideally within 72 hours.

Thanks,
John
John Smith
Security Program Manager
Acme Corp
john.smith@acmecorp.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: John Smith <john.smith@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test executive summary and transfer plan

John — thanks for the heads up. We can provide an executive summary immediately and coordinate delivery of the redacted report + evidence. Quick answers up front:

- Executive summary: yes — attached as a PDF (redacted_pt_exec_summary_v1.pdf). It contains scope, high-level findings, and remediation status.
- Scope: Hosted API (production public endpoints), API key management, customer data flows, and control-plane interfaces. The test was performed against prod-like infra by our retained pen-test provider on 2027-05-18 to 2027-05-21 against the model-serving edge and control plane.
- Transfer options: we support short-lived S3 presigned URLs (encrypted at rest with KMS), AES-256 encrypted ZIP (password exchange via separate channel), or upload to our secure evidence portal (link-based access, short TTL).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which transfer option you prefer. For S3 presigned we’ll need a point of contact and expected expiry window (we typically do 7 days, can shorten to 48 hours).
2) If you need **unredacted** material, we require an NDA amendment and a signed request from procurement; that takes longer.
3) Laura/Evelyn — can you review the attached summary and the proposed redaction manifest? I’ve attached a redaction manifest (redaction_manifest_v1.csv) that lists items to be removed before we share the full report.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that’s easier.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, John Smith <john.smith@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test executive summary and transfer plan

John / team — attaching a short redaction plan and proposed manifest. Highlights:

- We will redact tester IDs, internally scoped IPs, and any SSH keys or temporary credentials that could be used to access our infra.
- Findings that are customer-impacting will remain with sufficient context; code snippets or exact exploit PoCs are removed.
- Remediation status: we’ve included a column in the manifest with remediation dates and PR references where applicable.

Suggested delivery: AES-256 ZIP encrypted with a generated password, and S3 presigned link for the ZIP. Password will be shared over a separate channel (we can call or use your vendor key exchange flow). If you prefer portal access, we can provision an account with 48-hour TTL.

If that works, Marcus/Evelyn will prepare the package and provide the transfer instructions (s3-share-instructions.txt).

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: John Smith <john.smith@acmecorp.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmecorp.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test executive summary and transfer plan

Thanks — the plan looks good. Fast answers: 48-hour TTL for portal access or a 48-hour S3 presigned link is acceptable. For the password exchange, we prefer an encrypted out-of-band note (we can receive a PGP-encrypted email at security@acmecorp.com) — can you confirm you can send the password that way?

Also, please include the remediation ticket IDs for any critical/high findings; our auditors will want cross-references.

If you can deliver within the next 24 hours, that would meet our compliance window.

Best,
John
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: John Smith <john.smith@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test executive summary and transfer plan

John — confirmed. Actions taken:

- Attached: redacted_pt_exec_summary_v1.pdf (executive summary), redaction_manifest_v1.csv (findings + remediation tickets), s3-share-instructions.txt (transfer steps).
- Delivery method: we created an AES-256 encrypted ZIP containing the redacted report and supplemental evidence, hosted on a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket. We will send a presigned URL that expires in 48 hours.
- Password: we will PGP-encrypt the ZIP password and send to security@acmecorp.com in a separate email within the hour.
- Remediation cross-refs: check the manifest; critical/high rows include PR/issue IDs (e.g., RDW-4321, RDW-4389).

Expect the presigned URL shortly. If you prefer portal access instead, let us know and we’ll switch the workflow.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — happy to provide any additional artifacts the auditors request.

Regards,
Marcus
[Attachment stubs referenced above]
- redacted_pt_exec_summary_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
- redaction_manifest_v1.csv (text/csv)
- s3-share-instructions.txt (text/plain)
